page_title: RSO 1-2 ALA | Real Sociedad v Alaves 28/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Jose Sanchez is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' It must be a yellow card. It is. Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
90+7' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Jose Sanchez lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
90+7' A yellow card for bad language! Manu Sanchez (Alaves) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
90+7' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
90+4' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Real Sociedad.
90+1' A substitution has been made. Carlos Vicente goes off and Antonio Blanco (Alaves) comes on.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The expression of the referee Jose Sanchez is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Antonio Sivera (Alaves) is shown a yellow card.
88' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Sociedad.
86' Jose Sanchez blows the whistle, Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) is penalised for a foul.
84' Neat passing move from Real Sociedad in order to create new attacking opportunities.
82' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
81' Substitution. Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) has come on for Sergio Gomez.
81' Imanol Alguacil decides to make a substitution. Brais Mendez will be replaced by Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad).
81' Today's match ends for Igor Zubeldia who will be replaced by Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad).
79' Toni Martinez (Alaves) challenges for the lofted pass into the centre of the box, but has to stretch too much and sends his header narrowly wide of the left post.
77' 1 - 2 Toni Martinez (Alaves) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable low shot into the middle of the net.
77' Alaves are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
74' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

73' What a chance that is! Toni Martinez (Alaves) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the left post!
73' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

71' Kike Garcia (Alaves) receives a quality pass and unleashes a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just over the crossbar. The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
70' That's the end of the game for Abderrahmane Rebbach, who is replaced by Toni Martinez (Alaves).
69' Ander Guevara (Alaves) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
67' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.
66' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
66' Here comes a substitution. Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) is brought on as a substitute for Sheraldo Becker.
63' Here comes a substitution. Asier Villalibre is given a rest as he is replaced by Kike Garcia (Alaves).
63' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Manu Sanchez (Alaves) replacing Moussa Diarra.
62' A corner kick by Real Sociedad is thwarted by the well prepared Antonio Sivera (Alaves).
62' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
61' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
60' Jon Guridi (Alaves) is able to continue to play.
56' Jon Guridi (Alaves) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
54' Asier Villalibre (Alaves) tries to get on the end of a cross in a crowded box, but under pressure his header from near the penalty spot slips well wide of the right post.

53' Real Sociedad slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
51' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post.
49' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
48' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
48' Stoichkov (Alaves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Sanchez had an easy-decision to make.

47' Alex Remiro was forced into action to thwart Carlos Vicente (Alaves). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
46' Luis Garcia Plaza has made a change at the break. Stoichkov has come on in place of Carlos Benavidez (Alaves).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Imanol Alguacil gives a chance to Jon Martin and Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) is off.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+7' Jose Sanchez interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Carlos Benavidez (Alaves).
45+5' 1 - 1 Goal! Asier Villalibre (Alaves) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Alex Remiro into right side of the goal.
45+5' Asier Villalibre (Alaves) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45+4' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul. That's a penalty to Alaves! They have a good chance to score now.
45+3' Alaves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+3' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad). Jose Sanchez saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
45+2' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
45' The current number of shots on goal is 1:1.
43' The Real Sociedad players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
43' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Alaves comes to nothing.
42' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
38' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
36' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) has tested the patience of referee Jose Sanchez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
32' 1 - 0 Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) converts a killer cross with a powerful low shot that goes into the middle of the net.
29' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is shown a red card and his teammates aren't happy! He must leave the pitch.
29' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he’s going to review that incident from earlier. It could result in a red card, but for who as a number of players were involved?
24' A lofted cross from Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
23' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
22' Real Sociedad seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
19' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
16' Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) for his blatant foul.
14' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
12' Great teamplay by Alaves as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
10' Asier Villalibre (Alaves) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the left side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
9' The referee signals a corner kick to Alaves.

9' What a great chance for Carlos Benavidez (Alaves). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header right under the bar, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
9' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
8' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
7' Real Sociedad fail to score from a corner as Antonio Sivera (Alaves) leaps to collect the ball.
5' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the left post.
5' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
5' A poor attempt from the edge of the box. Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) dragged a first-time shot well wide of the right post.
3' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
2' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad).
1' Wonderful movement by Real Sociedad. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Alaves will take the kick-off.
Jose Sanchez is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
